story.text: 승객 여러분, 이번 목적지는 한국 공연 예술의 심장, '대학로'입니다. 막이 오르기 전 함께 준비해볼까요?
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, i-beon mok-jeok-ji-neun han-guk gong-yeon ye-sul-ui sim-jang, dae-hak-ro-im-ni-da.
story.en: Passengers, our next destination is 'Daehak-ro', the heart of Korean performing arts. Shall we get ready before the curtain rises?

story.text: 이 거리엔 작은 극장, '소극장'들이 백 개도 넘게 모여 있어요. 골목마다 다른 이야기가 펼쳐지죠.
story.reading: i geo-ri-en jag-eun geuk-jang, so-geuk-jang-deul-i baeg gae-do neom-ge mo-yeo i-sseo-yo.
story.en: This street is home to over a hundred small theaters, 'sogeukjang'. A different story unfolds down every alley.

story.text: 소극장에서 보는 '연극'은 배우와 관객이 아주 가까워요. 숨소리까지 다 들릴 정도죠.
story.reading: so-geuk-jang-e-seo bo-neun yeon-geug-eun bae-u-wa gwan-gaeg-i a-ju ga-kka-wo-yo.
story.en: In a 'play' at a small theater, the actors and audience are extremely close — you can even hear their breathing.

story.text: 물론 큰 극장에선 화려한 '뮤지컬'도 즐길 수 있어요. 한국 뮤지컬 수준은 세계적으로도 유명하답니다.
story.reading: mul-lon keun geuk-jang-e-seon hwa-ryeo-han myu-ji-keol-do jeul-gil su i-sseo-yo.
story.en: Of course, you can also enjoy a lavish 'musical' at the big theaters. Korean musicals are world-renowned.

story.text: 그리고 그 모든 무대의 중심엔 '배우'가 있죠. 몸짓 하나로 관객을 울고 웃게 만드는 사람들이에요.
story.reading: geu-ri-go geu mo-deun mu-dae-ui jung-sim-en bae-u-ga it-jyo.
story.en: And at the center of every stage stands the 'actor' — the people who make the audience laugh and cry with a single gesture.

story.text: 박수 소리가 들리는 것 같지 않나요? 이제 오늘 배운 단어로 커튼콜을 준비해봐요!
story.reading: bak-su so-ri-ga deul-li-neun geot gat-ji an-na-yo?
story.en: Can you almost hear the applause? Now let's prepare for the curtain call with today's words!

words.example_en: Daehak-ro is the street of theater.
This small theater puts you very close to the actors.
I booked tickets for tonight's play.
The level of Korean musicals is really high.
That actor's performance is truly wonderful.

sentences.en: There are so many performance venues in Daehak-ro.
In a small theater, the actors and audience are close.

sentences.ko: 연극을 보고 나면 여운이 오래 남습니다.
sentences.reading: yeon-geug-eul bo-go na-myeon yeo-un-i o-rae nam-seum-ni-da
sentences.en: The lingering feeling stays long after watching a play.
A musical's stage is splendid and grand.
The actors' passion is conveyed to the audience.
